name: prism
description: Prism's Claude Code skills: data skills (classify, extract entities, reconcile, schema-bridge, wikilinks) plus a prism-setup family that sets up a Prism step by step, matching the app's setup checklist: vault and token, server and secure storage, tag schemas, an agent's own access token, reaching the server from other devices (Tailscale or a Cloudflare tunnel), and optional integrations.
